repository_sources.title: The geometric case of the Erdős similarity conjecture
repository_sources.retrieval: GitHub connector; exact source snapshots retained during research.
repository_sources.role: Direct antecedent for finite ordered-tree routing, selector tables, first-default tests, local grid counting, and exceptional-center repair. The required estimates are reproduced in the article.
repository_sources.qualification: The inspected main result treats a fixed geometric ratio. Fixed bounded-ratio novelty is not inferred from this source alone; the separate ProveIt polynomial-family theorem must also be considered.

repository_sources.title: Uniform geometric avoidance
repository_sources.version: Repository snapshot at the pinned commit
repository_sources.retrieval: GitHub connector; exact source content and returned Git blob identifiers recorded.
repository_sources.role: Prior simultaneous geometric and positive-real-root exponential-polynomial avoidance, polynomial-family theorem, effectivity, and explicit oscillatory-recurrence research question.
repository_sources.prior_case_acknowledgment: The polynomial-family theorem on a singleton parameter space already covers fixed sequences with two-sided adjacent-ratio bounds. First-crossing extraction gives the fixed positive eventual lower-ratio case. These are not claimed new.
repository_sources.qualification: The earlier discussion already suggests consecutive state coordinates. The present signed selection proof, full sign-condition count, compact exhaustion, and uniform assembly are distinguished from that suggestion.
